claim_gate.reason: Surviving architectures still need useful collective effects, outcome rules and natural reductions. Binary detection is kept separate from identification; known access primitives are not algorithms.

additional_proof_obligations: Supply a uniform polynomial-length coherent or adaptive subset program; do not enumerate all 2^k subsets or complete multiplicity bases.
Prove constant source-weighted null-versus-class trace distance for its actual outcome law, not only an optimal residual measurement.
Use clean GPE compute-copy-uncompute with charged error; discarding Fourier rows changes the instrument even when label probabilities agree.
Construct a growing-copy outcome classifier. The exact polynomial two-copy score is only a calibration and its signal vanishes asymptotically.
Prove a promise-preserving natural binary reduction and preparation cost; no hidden-element recovery is inferred from detection.
Compare with legal classical graph/code algorithms, actual-source tensor contractions and known measured-sieve models. Leaving a sieve definition is not advantage.
Falsify fixed-copy repetition and any use of the hypothesis-dependent latent initial distribution as a free classical sampler.

Count subset-incidence cells, not just raw copies: a fixed palette has at most 2^q-1 effective samples unless source-label or other access refines it. Do not apply that bound after retaining unaccounted individual source labels.

Retained classical source labels need the separate source-conditioned bound: compress large cells and charge small cells as full raw quantum inputs. Fixed preselected cell profiles remain obstructed asymptotically. Specify source-dependent regrouping and every outside-algebra readout; a vacuous bound is not a positive signal.

Classical adaptation within a small predetermined whole-execution catalogue pays a sum of aborting-comparison bounds. Do not normalize selected successes, use a step-only cover or infer runtime from catalogue size. Specify the actual selector and final readout beyond this restriction.

The explicit coherent subset-phase program now has a verified conditional Walsh contraction and charged primitive counts, not a growing-degree classifier. Preserve source-selector correlations, beat disjoint-pair and pair-plus-total controls, and do not confuse fixed-group copy scaling with degree scaling. Fixed O(log n) mask marginals remain obstructed under the one-query contract; arbitrary full-bit decisions are not covered.

Explicit parity and threshold terminal rules now exist. Any fixed parity reduces to an input-independent random two-subset Hadamard test; bounded Fourier l1 norm transfers the obstruction to source-corrected all-zero rules. Seek a genuinely collective large-norm output rule with proved signal, not a source-selected-support shortcut. Cheap majority evaluation has exponential Fourier norm and is not excluded by this argument.

Source-selected parity is now executable and its exact character contraction reaches S6. Corrected negative-character selection loses to even one pair for every k>=2 by an exact prefix and moment-tail certificate. Do not present escaping the fixed-parity theorem as evidence of success; the finite-degree failure does not rule out arbitrary source-based classifiers at growing degree.

primitive_specs.role: Prepare k independent coset states.
Apply the solved S_n QFT registerwise.
Clean compute-copy-uncompute label access on supplied subsets; conditional on charged QFT and controlled actions. No multiplicity basis or hidden alignment is supplied.
Specify a uniform growing-copy collective program with natural source-weighted detection advantage and no destructive uncharged workspace discard.
Compute a decision from measured outcomes at polynomial cost; two-copy character scores and ideal Helstrom tables do not supply this.
Justify the complete decision reduction for a natural input, including its automorphism promise, preparation costs and legal classical baseline.
Conditional two-QFT carrier extraction for a known reference subgroup; primitive/basis contract remains review-pending, not unknown alignment.
Construct a source-aware collective effect, retaining carrier or reference correlations needed to break fixed-K invariance.
Independently dephase each reference type and discard its carrier; known references fixed independently of input and outcomes.
Apply an arbitrary collective effect to the remaining independently twirled multiplicity codes.
Measure only irrep labels.
Estimate invariant-space or multiplicity statistics.
Measure or coherently expose target tableau/Gelfand--Tsetlin labels while retaining multiplicity degeneracy.
Resolve every copy label with one bounded-norm, uniformly inverse-polynomial-gap commutant Hamiltonian; this fixed complete-label primitive is obstructed.
Resolve pair irreps and multiplicity bases coherently.
Use an exceptional multiplicity-free or commuting promise.
Recouple in one fixed binary tree.
Apply a spectrum/rank-derived measurement in that tree.
Move coherently among overlapping recoupling trees.
Implement state-dependent frame inverse/transition weights.
Approximate recoupling and frame action by a tensor network.
Decode from weak labels.
Decode from multiplicity statistics.
Decode a compressed collective outcome.
Verify a proposed hidden permutation on the natural instance.

summary: Evaluated 10 typed collective-measurement architectures, rejected 6 known-invalid shortcuts, and retained 4 proof-capability research proposals without promoting candidates.
